title: Interbreeding with Denisovans
summary: Modern humans mix with Denisovans, an archaic group known mostly from DNA. About 4-6% of Melanesian genomes come from Denisovans.
why: A whole human lineage was discovered largely through the DNA it left in us.

notes.problem: Place 'Eastern Asia' not in source; source says mixing came before entry into Sahul and 'did not take place in the regions near southern Siberia'.
